## api/cancel-order

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  s0(["POST /orders/:id/cancel"])
  s1["1. Read the order<br/>• Return HTTP 404 when it does not exist.<br/>• Return HTTP 409 when it is not paid or is older than 24 hours."]
  s2["2. Refund the payment with Stripe<br/>• Return HTTP 502 when Stripe does not answer."]
  s3["3. Save the order with the status cancelled"]
  s4["4. Publish order.cancelled with the items of the order"]
  s5["5. Return the order id and the new status"]
  s0 --> s1 --> s2 --> s3 --> s4 --> s5
  x0[("Postgres")]
  s0 -.-|reads| x0
  x1(["Stripe API"])
  s0 -.-|calls| x1
  s0 -.-|writes| x0
  x2(["Kafka topic order.events"])
  s0 -.-|publishes| x2
```

## api/create-order

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  s0(["POST /orders"])
  s1["1. Validate the body<br/>• Return HTTP 400 when it is not valid."]
  s2["2. Read the products of the cart and their prices<br/>• Return HTTP 409 when a product does not exist, is not active, or has less stock than the quantity."]
  s3["3. Save the order with the status pending"]

  s0 --> s1 --> s2 --> s3 --> s4 --> s5
```


## api/stripe-webhook

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  s0(["POST /webhooks/stripe"])
```

## worker/update-stock

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  s0(["order.events"])
  s1["1. Skip each event that is not order.paid or order.cancelled"]
  s2["2. Take the quantity of each item out of the stock, in one transaction<br/>• Do it only for order.paid.<br/>• Skip the event when its id is already in stock_events.<br/>• Record the event id in stock_events."]
  s3["3. Put the quantity of each item back in the stock, in one transaction<br/>• Do it only for order.cancelled.<br/>• Skip the event when its id is already in stock_events.<br/>• Record the event id in stock_events."]
  s0 --> s1 --> s2 --> s3
  x0(["Kafka topic order.events"])
  s0 -.-|consumes| x0
  x1[("Postgres")]
  s0 -.-|writes| x1
```
